en: A black-and-white aerial photograph depicting a large manor house surrounded by meticulously landscaped gardens, footpaths, and outbuildings. The house appears to be of neoclassical or baroque design, with a symmetrical facade and a grand staircase leading to the entrance. The surrounding area includes formal gardens, agricultural fields, greenhouses, and a dock leading to a body of water. The setting is rural, with fields and forested areas in the background.
